about: Punch list #217, Show it, don't say it: the saved picks. One row per finding id: pick (build | later | drop | null), note (the owner's words, cleared once a session acts on them), at (when the pick was pressed), handledAt (when the note was acted on). The page loads this file when built (build.sh); Export picks on the page writes a new one. Save it here and commit.
